summary: Both original full-test shards completed; exact full-curve/metric/GT/provenance CPU checks pass. Legacy scoring, source/receipt-only remote provenance, one-seed scope and unpaired timing require qualification.

A_gt_provenance.details: Test sequences are enumerated from the frozen dataset manifest; the tracking entry reads dataset init.txt, and writes the float32 annotation array separately from predictions. All 245 serialized GT arrays / 220703 rows exactly equal the supplied local canonical LasHeR toolkit GT as float32, before and after round(0). The 882 train, 97 dev and 245 test name sets are unique and pairwise disjoint. No GT is derived from predictions. This review did not reread original remote init.txt/JPG bytes or authenticate the local toolkit against an official published release; provenance beyond the supplied local canonical copy is source/receipt traced.

B_score_normalization.details: The scorer uses fixed benchmark thresholds, per-sequence rates and sequence-equal arithmetic means multiplied by 100. NPR normalizes coordinates by GT width/height plus 1e-8, not by prediction extrema. PR is the <=20-pixel rate, NPR the <=0.20 rate, and SR the arithmetic mean of 21 strict-IoU-threshold success rates; SR is not trapezoidal integration. Internal score/sum entropy in model.py is a model input, not reported score normalization. Legacy special-GT/initialization semantics are disclosed separately.

C_results_and_identity.details: All 743 raw shard files equal their supplied sealed inventory before and after verification. Predictions are finite with positive widths/heights. Exact unique coverage is 245 sequences, 220703 frame predictions, 245 initializations and 220458 contiguous trace rows. Actual native tasks 478338/478426 are COMPLETE/child exit0, with launch/completion task/PID/argv/config identities bound. Stored curves (30135 values), all 735 per-sequence metrics and all aggregate accuracy/timing values exactly match two CPU reconstructions. The checkpoint hash and cost0 match the frozen dev-selected final-C882 configuration. No new checkpoint loading or live native-process observation was performed.

D_active_metric_and_causal_paths.details: The scorer instantiates and calls PR_LasHeR, NPR and SR_LasHeR, serializes their curves and derives the reported values. The collected CPU scorer transport records exit0, and the fresh verifier dynamically observed two calls per class while reproducing the stored output. Inference goes through run_with_crop_api to scripts/run_tracking.py. Only frame0 receives GT initialization; later calls are tracker.track(image). Search is centered on the previous predicted state; selected predictions update state/history, and periodic confidence-gated templates crop that predicted state. No per-frame GT forcing is present in the inspected call chain. This is source/trace evidence, without a new NN replay.

E_scope_and_claims.details: This is one full LasHeR test of original E0 after 882-sequence/two-round C training, fixed final checkpoint and cost0 chosen by the preregistered three-dev-candidate rule; training/inference seed2027. It is not dev97, historical C20, candidate E1, RGBT210/RGBT234 completion, a multi-seed study, a module ablation or a speedup experiment. All three updated LasHeR targets remain unmet. Service timing was collected on two concurrent shards and is unpaired; mean/P95/service-FPS are descriptive only. The supplied HANDOFF/ISSUES snapshot still says collection is blocked by SSH; the later closed artifacts supersede that historical observation but do not attest the original controller final status.

F_evaluation_type.details: Dataset-provided canonical GT scores causal saved model predictions. This is real_gt benchmark evaluation under the supplied legacy toolkit protocol, not model-derived proxy agreement. Source-derived causal behavior and real-GT numeric recomputation support this classification; no new model execution or external official-toolkit certification is claimed.

scope: Original E0 C882 full LasHeR test only

verification.freeze_chronology: Controller writes/copies frozen selection before launch; tracking asserts checkpoint/cost equality before model construction. Same freeze hash is in the launch-time and completed snapshots. No independent timestamp of the freeze write is present.
verification.gt_provenance: Manifest test name set and source dataset init.txt; all serialized GT equals local canonical toolkit GT after float32/round(0). Original remote init.txt/image bytes were not re-read.

legacy_scoring_semantics: Load both canonical GT and predictions as float32 and apply NumPy round(0), including its half-to-even rounding.
The toolkit replaces each first prediction by its first GT, but keeps that initialization frame in the denominator; it does not remove the frame.

After replacement, the toolkit truncates to GT length and carries forward the previous prediction for a nonpositive rounded width/height. Exact original lengths were separately checked and zero predictions required this repair.

A GT row with any component <=0 is assigned error/overlap -1. Hence it counts as a PR and NPR success at every threshold and an SR failure at every threshold; these rows remain in the denominator. There are 1260 such rows: 533 with nonpositive width/height, 727 position-only, including one initialization.
Centers use (width-1)/2 and (height-1)/2; IoU uses inclusive last coordinates (left+width-1, top+height-1) and +1 intersection widths/heights.
PR thresholds are linspace(0,50,51) with <=; NPR thresholds are linspace(0,.5,51) with <= and index20; SR thresholds are linspace(0,1,21) with strict >. All sequences have equal weight.

NumPy1.26.4 scalar float32 operands combined with Python -1, /2. and +1e-8 promote to float64. The independent checker preserves this scalar behavior after float32 loading/rounding, while retaining float32 area products. Production scorer/toolkit bytes were unchanged.

limitations: The local canonical toolkit/GT is hash-sealed, not newly authenticated against an official release; this report certifies exact reproduction of the supplied legacy protocol.

Remote original annotations/images and checkpoint tensor bytes were not reread. Checkpoint linkage uses config/frozen hashes and the supplied earlier completed-training audit; its tensor-freeze findings are not newly reattested here.

Freeze-before-inference is supported by controller write/copy-before-launch order, the active pre-model checkpoint/cost assertions and identical launch/completion freeze hashes. The selection JSON contains no standalone timestamp of its write; no independently timestamped freeze event is available.

Native child COMPLETE/exit0 comes from already collected status/observation artifacts and their source implementation. No live process, controller-final-state or operating-system liveness claim is made.
Causal search/template updates are source/trace checked. No neural replay or independent capture of in-memory tensors was performed.
One checkpoint and seed2027 do not establish seed robustness, statistical significance, three module contributions or three-benchmark completion.
Service mean/P95/FPS include decoding and initialization and exclude model loading and per-frame result-file writing; they are not paired with a baseline or candidate and do not prove a speedup.
User-provided baseline metrics were not rerun. Numerical differences from them are descriptive only, not a newly matched baseline experiment.

checker_failures.diagnosis: Float32 array arithmetic differed from legacy NumPy1.26 scalar promotion. First sequence had one threshold comparison difference; scalar-versus-float64 vector errors were exactly zero.
checker_failures.correction: New immutable verify_cpu_r2.py uses float64 scalar-equivalent center/normalization arithmetic after unchanged float32 loading/rounding and preserves float32 area products.
